summary: The same every-minute catalogue sync, fetching only products changed since a saved (updated_at, sku) cursor, capped at 20 pages a run, and upserting only rows whose values differ.

must_not_flag.reason: The upsert's WHERE skips rows whose values are unchanged, and the run only receives products the supplier changed since the saved cursor; an unchanged catalogue costs one indexed read per minute.

The cursor is saved after each page is written, under the same name the next run reads, and it pairs updated_at with the SKU so products that share a timestamp are not fetched again. Each run starts where the last one ended, reads at most 20 pages with a fetch timeout, and a failed run keeps the pages it finished.
